segments.text: City centre. One parking space left. In the multi-storey car park.
But the barrier isn't a barrier. It's a giraffe. What do you do?
Big mistake. The giraffe jumps up in fright. Straight through all four floors.
Now it walks off, wearing the car park like a scarf. With every car still inside. And you? Still no parking space.
Here's how you do it properly.
Take the little tree off your mirror. And hold it out of the window.
The giraffe sees a tree. Up goes the neck.
One nibble. Pine flavour. Its favourite.
And to say thank you, it lifts your car all the way up. Into the last space, on the roof.
Next exam question: a sheepdog runs the roundabout. Follow, so you don't miss it.
